천.forms: Sino-Korean · money, large numbers (천 원, 삼천, 천만)
천.e: 천 원 = 1,000 won, the smallest Korean bill.

콘서트.ex: 다음 주에 좋아하는 가수 콘서트에 가요.
콘서트.x: Next week I'm going to my favorite singer's concert.

지우다.m: to erase, to delete; to remove (makeup, stains)
지우다.x: I deleted the photos I didn't need from my phone.
지우다.e: Related to 지우개 'eraser': -개 turns the verb into a tool.

언제나.ex: 할머니는 언제나 저를 반갑게 맞아 주세요.
언제나.x: My grandmother always welcomes me warmly.

아끼다.m: to save, to use sparingly; to cherish, to treasure
아끼다.ex: 용돈을 아껴서 친구 생일 선물을 샀어요.
아끼다.x: I saved my allowance and bought a birthday present for my friend.
아끼다.e: Two senses share one idea — not wanting to lose something: 돈을 아끼다, 아끼는 사람.
아끼다.t: 제가 아끼는 후배 means 'a junior I really care about' — not about money at all.

방식.x: Everyone's way of studying is a little different.
방식.t: 방법 is a specific way to do something; 방식 is a general style or system.

그대로.forms: 그대로 두다 (leave as is); 그대로이다 (be the same)
그대로.m: as it is, as is, just like that; unchanged
그대로.ex: 제 방은 어렸을 때 모습 그대로예요.
그대로.x: My room is just the way it was when I was little.

겪다.m: to go through, to experience, to suffer
겪다.ex: 유학 생활 동안 많은 어려움을 겪었어요.
겪다.x: I went through a lot of hardships while studying abroad.
겪다.t: Usually used for difficulties: 어려움을 겪다, 고생을 겪다; for fun experiences, use 경험하다.

파출소.m: police box, small local police station
파출소.ex: 지갑을 주워서 근처 파출소에 갖다 줬어요.
파출소.x: I found a wallet and took it to the nearby police box.
파출소.e: Literally 'place officers are dispatched from'; -소 = place: 연구소, 주유소.

따지다.m: to argue, demand an explanation; to weigh, calculate carefully
따지다.ex: 가게에 가서 왜 환불이 안 되는지 따졌어요.
따지다.x: I went to the store and demanded to know why I couldn't get a refund.
따지다.t: 따져 보다 means 'to think it over carefully': 장단점을 따져 보세요 'weigh the pros and cons.'

집밥.ex: 자취한 지 오래돼서 엄마가 해 준 집밥이 그리워요.
집밥.x: I've lived on my own for a long time, so I miss my mom's home cooking.
집밥.t: Pronounced [집빱]. It suggests warm, simple food with rice, soup and side dishes; restaurants advertise 집밥 같은 'just like home cooking'.

관리자.x: If there's a problem with the building, contact the manager.
관리자.e: Literally 'person who controls and keeps order'.
관리자.t: Pronounced [괄리자] — ㄴ becomes ㄹ next to ㄹ.

급락.ex: 환율 급락 때문에 수출 기업들이 걱정하고 있습니다.
급락.x: Export companies are worried because of the sharp drop in the exchange rate.
급락.t: Pronounced [금낙]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ, then ㅂ becomes ㅁ.

독학.t: Pronounced [도칵]; 독학으로 배우다 means 'to teach yourself'.

성악.x: My friend majored in vocal music at a music college.
성악.e: Literally 'voice music', as opposed to 기악 'instrumental music'.

시사회.ex: 개봉 전에 기자들을 위한 시사회가 열렸습니다.
시사회.x: A press screening was held before the release.

일교차.m: daily temperature range (gap between day and night)
일교차.x: The temperature swings a lot between day and night these days, so watch out for colds.
일교차.t: Forecasts in spring and fall love 일교차가 크다; it's a hint to dress in layers.

마감일.x: The deadline for the application is this Friday.
마감일.t: Pronounced [마가밀]; 마감하다 means 'to close' applications or a shop for the day.

됨됨이.m: one's character, the kind of person one is
됨됨이.x: With people, character matters more than looks.
됨됨이.e: From 되다 'to become' — literally 'how a person has turned out'.

낙천적.ex: 그는 낙천적이라서 걱정을 별로 안 해요.
낙천적.x: He's optimistic, so he doesn't worry much.
낙천적.e: Literally 'enjoying heaven' — content with whatever fate brings.
낙천적.t: 낙천적 describes a personality; 낙관적 describes a view of a situation, as in 낙관적인 전망.

쓰러뜨리다.ex: 어린아이가 집 안에서 뛰다가 꽃병을 쓰러뜨렸어요.
쓰러뜨리다.x: The little kid was running around the house and knocked over the vase.
쓰러뜨리다.e: -뜨리다 makes a verb forceful or causative: 깨뜨리다, 넘어뜨리다.

인생샷.m: best photo ever (of oneself), photo of a lifetime
인생샷.ex: 바다 앞에서 친구가 제 인생샷을 찍어 줬어요.
인생샷.x: My friend took the best photo of my life in front of the sea.
인생샷.e: 인생 'life' + 샷 from English 'shot': the best shot of your life.
인생샷.t: Casual. A spot with a great backdrop is an 인생샷 명소, and finally getting that photo is 인생샷을 건지다.

상정.m: putting (a bill) on the agenda, submission to a session
상정.ex: 그 법안은 다음 주 본회의에 상정될 예정입니다.
상정.x: The bill is scheduled to be put on the agenda of next week's plenary session.
상정.e: Literally 'putting up on the schedule'; a homonym 상정 means 'assumption'.

안도감.x: I felt relieved at the news that the child was safe.
안도감.t: Collocation: 안도의 한숨을 쉬다 'breathe a sigh of relief'.

병력.ex: 정부는 국경 지역에 병력을 추가로 배치했습니다.
병력.x: The government deployed additional troops to the border region.
병력.e: Literally 'soldier power'. Homonym warning: a different 병력 means 'medical history'.
병력.t: Pronounced [병녁]: ㄹ after ㅇ becomes ㄴ.

수더분하다.ex: 새로 온 직원은 성격이 수더분해서 누구와도 잘 지내요.
수더분하다.x: The new employee is easygoing, so she gets along with everyone.
수더분하다.t: Suggests plain, approachable and not fussy about looks; similar to 털털하다.

속수무책.m: helplessness, being powerless to do anything
속수무책.x: The villagers were helpless against the sudden flood.
속수무책.t: Pronounced [속쑤무책]; often 속수무책으로 당하다 'to be helpless against'.

신자유주의.x: Starting in the 1980s, many countries adopted neoliberal policies.
신자유주의.e: 신- 'new' + 자유 'freedom' + -주의 '-ism,' a hugely productive suffix: 민주주의, 자본주의.

무신론.ex: 무신론을 주장하는 사람들도 종교의 역할은 인정하기도 해요.
무신론.x: Even people who argue for atheism sometimes acknowledge the role of religion.
무신론.t: Pronounced [무신논]: in this word ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㄴ.

소인배.ex: 작은 일에 화를 내면 소인배라는 말을 들을 수 있어요.
소인배.x: If you get angry over small things, people may call you petty.
소인배.e: Literally 'the small-person crowd' — opposite of the virtuous 군자.
소인배.t: Common insult for petty behavior; the playful slang opposite is 대인배 (a magnanimous person).

리비도.ex: 프로이트는 리비도를 인간 행동의 중요한 에너지로 보았어요.
리비도.x: Freud saw libido as an important energy behind human behavior.
리비도.e: From Latin/English 'libido'; Korean uses it mostly in psychology, less in casual talk.

수소차.x: A hydrogen car emits only water while driving.

인지상정.m: human nature, what anyone would naturally feel
인지상정.ex: 어려운 사람을 돕고 싶은 것은 인지상정이에요.
인지상정.x: Wanting to help people in need is only human.
인지상정.t: Used to call a feeling natural: -는 것은 인지상정이다 'it's only human to …'.

신분상승.m: rise in social status, climbing the social ladder
신분상승.ex: 드라마에서는 결혼을 통한 신분상승 이야기가 자주 나와요.
신분상승.x: Stories of climbing the social ladder through marriage often appear in dramas.
신분상승.e: Literally 'status ascent'; 신분 is one's place in society.

반문화.x: The hippie movement of the 1960s was a classic counterculture.

사회적 기업.forms: 사회적 기업을 세우다 · 사회적 기업에서 일하다
사회적 기업.ex: 그는 장애인을 고용하는 사회적 기업을 운영하고 있어요.
사회적 기업.x: He runs a social enterprise that employs people with disabilities.
사회적 기업.e: -적 turns a noun into 'related to X': 사회적 'social', 경제적 'economic'.

라니냐.ex: 라니냐 때문에 올겨울은 더 추울 것으로 예상됩니다.
라니냐.x: This winter is expected to be colder because of La Niña.
라니냐.e: From Spanish 'La Niña' ('the girl'), named as the opposite of El Niño.

봉합하다.m: to patch up (a conflict); to suture
봉합하다.x: The two parties temporarily patched up their conflict.
봉합하다.e: Literally 'sew together': first a wound, then a rift.
봉합하다.t: Often implies a surface fix: 갈등을 봉합하다 suggests the problem may come back.
